description:
The archive execution summary, duplicated byte for byte in two archive arms, moves into one renderer beside the existing archive renderers.

## Background

`ArchiveCommands::Document` and `ArchiveCommands::Container` in `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or the archive handler module once moved) each print the same block after executing an archive: an `Archive execution complete: …` line followed by `warning:` lines. The preview and candidates views already go through `output::render_archive_plan` and `render_archive_candidates`, so the execution view is the only archive view rendered inline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The output module exposes one archive execution renderer, beside `render_archive_plan`, that prints the completion line and warnings.
- [hard] REQ-02: `archive document` and `archive container` print their execution summary only through it, and their human output is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: One unit test owns the renderer's output, and the archive CLI suites pass without assertion changes.

## Notes

Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md`.
title: One output renderer for archive execution summaries
